as_told.title: Lights over Duke Energy plant video

plain: In 2024, lights were filmed in the sky right next to the Brunswick nuclear plant, run by the power company Duke Energy in Southport, North Carolina. Michels brings it up himself as an example of strange objects showing up near nuclear sites. Later he calls it "UAP activity", using the newer official term for UFOs, and credits a well-known UFO skeptic named Mick West for pinning down which facility it was.
